verdict.rationale: Aircall is a SaaS telephony platform with a public API, so an official CLI is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence shows only a REST API reference with curl samples, a Postman collection and webhook tutorials, and none of it mentions a first-party command-line tool. Curl samples and Postman are developer building blocks, not an official CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
